tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H ≤ 0.48, while the target is H = 22.5. The authorized mechanism guidance identifies slow adaptation as a distinct component, so long-horizon observations are needed before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the sink-coupled dual-horizon model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short horizons do not identify the slow adaptation timescale needed for the 22.5-horizon forecast.
The slow-horizon probe directly targets the unresolved long-term reversal.
